Ritika Thakur
Digital Marketing Manager | Mumbai
ritika.thakur237@example.com | +91 9797546341

Performance-driven digital marketing manager with experience designing and executing data-led acquisition campaigns for B2B and B2C products. Strong focus on measurable ROI, funnel optimization, and cross-functional delivery using Agile practices. Experienced in leveraging analytics to reduce CPA and increase conversion rates.

Experience

Covalent Infotech — Apr 2024 - Present
Digital Marketing Manager (Remote)
- Launched a Google Ads search and display program that reduced average CPA by 28% within three months by refining keyword targets and bid strategies using Google Ads and Google Analytics.
- Built a content and paid social calendar that increased lead volume 2.1x quarter-over-quarter while improving lead quality, tracked via UTM tagging and Google Analytics.
- Implemented Social Media Marketing processes and A/B tests for creative and CTA variants, increasing conversion rate from social by 35% and reducing CPL by 22%.
- Coordinated campaign delivery with product and engineering teams using Jira and Agile rituals; maintained creative and landing page versioning with Git to speed deployment cycles.

Ledgerly — Jun 2023 - Mar 2024
Digital Marketing Manager (On-site)
- Designed and executed SEM and Google Ads campaigns focused on high-intent accounting keywords, cutting average CPL by 31% and increasing MQL-to-SQL conversion by 19%.
- Optimized landing pages and ad copy through iterative experiments measured in Google Analytics, which improved form completion rate by 26%.
- Launched remarketing and audience segmentation strategies across paid search and social channels, delivering a 42% uplift in returning visitor conversions.
- Partnered with product and growth teams in Agile sprints and tracked tasks in Jira; used Git for maintaining campaign assets and landing page templates.

Projects
- Lead Magnet Campaigns: Developed a series of gated ebook and webinar funnels promoted through Google Ads and Social Media Marketing; resulted in 3,200+ qualified leads and automated nurturing sequences integrated with CRM.
- SEM Playbook: Authored an internal SEM playbook documenting keyword research, bidding strategies, ad copy templates, and measurement approaches used across teams.

Skills
Languages: SEO, SEM
Advertising & Analytics: Google Ads, Google Analytics, Social Media Marketing
Delivery & Tools: Jira, Agile, Git

Education
B.E., Information Technology, Pune University
